reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because its tutorial directs viewers to send Bitcoin to a BitConnect address and use the deposited balance to buy BCC. It presents BitConnect lending and reinvestment controls alongside a daily-profit and capital-back claim, promoting participation in that flow. the available video evidence does not establish that returns were paid or losses occurred.

citations.quote: How To Transfer Bitcoin From Coinbase To BITCONNECT!!!!
today i'm going to show you guys how to transfer your Bitcoin from your coinbase wallet to the big connects platform
Because bitcoin the minimum that you can lend on that site is 100 hundred
the network have a fee to do the transaction which is three dollars and eighty-five cents
I sent $102 to the external address of bigconnect

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker describes a cautious personal test, not a promised result: “I'm starting out small” to “test the waters.” The walkthrough also discloses a network fee and says the funds will not appear until the transaction processes. Those details give viewers uncertainty and cost at the point of transfer. The speaker does not claim in the narration that this test has earned a return.

citations.quote: I'm starting out small so I can you know test the waters a little bit with this
coinbase have a network fee they have a fee well the network have a fee to do the transaction
we have to wait to the transaction process when it processes the amount will show here in your Bitcoin wallet

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited lending minimum identifies an amount, not a return the speaker received. Likewise, the reported send establishes a transfer, not a completed lending investment. The speaker calls the amount a small test; the opening gives that qualification too little weight.

citations.quote: Because bitcoin the minimum that you can lend on that site is 100 hundred
I sent $102 to the external address of bigconnect
I'm starting out small so I can you know test the waters a little bit with this

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the amount a test does not turn this into an investigation or warning. The speaker instructs viewers through a transfer to BitConnect and identifies a lending minimum. The dashboard also presents daily profit and return of capital as reasons to participate. A completed payout is unnecessary to recognize what the walkthrough promotes.

citations.quote: today i'm going to show you guys how to transfer your Bitcoin from your coinbase wallet to the big connects platform
Because bitcoin the minimum that you can lend on that site is 100 hundred

opening.argument: Judge, the center of this video is an operational demonstration. The speaker explains how to select a Bitcoin wallet, check the copied destination, account for a network fee, and wait for confirmations before expecting a balance. Even the later BCC discussion describes where the buy control is after funds arrive. Those are instructions for navigating interfaces; the narration does not show a realized return from lending.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's transfer quotes accurately describe the tutorial, but an explanation of how to send funds is not itself proof that lending produced returns. The speaker explicitly says the transaction must process before the balance appears; the cited send therefore should not be read as a completed investment.

citations.quote: I sent $102 to the external address of bigconnect
we have to wait to the transaction process when it processes the amount will show here in your Bitcoin wallet

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructions are precisely what makes this consequential: the speaker tells viewers how to send Bitcoin to BitConnect, names its lending minimum, and then explains buying BCC. The visible dashboard presents daily profit and capital back. The absence of a realized return limits what can be claimed about outcomes, but it does not make the participation walkthrough merely neutral technical education.

citations.quote: this is how you're going to receive your Bitcoin to this platform to buy bit connect
Because bitcoin the minimum that you can lend on that site is 100 hundred
you want to buy BCC which is big connect coined

opening.argument: Judge, the visible end point is a buy/sell interface for BCC, and the speaker describes moving Bitcoin into a wallet before making a purchase. The description provides join links for both services. This record does show a deposit workflow and a passing reference to a lending minimum, so those points cannot be dismissed. But the narrated transaction establishes neither that the speaker lent the funds nor that anyone received a promised payout or downline income. On the demonstrated steps, the narrower reading is a purchase workflow.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly identifies the external transfer, but its cited send does not establish that the money was lent. The speaker's later instruction is to buy BCC once Bitcoin becomes available. That distinction matters when judging what transaction this demonstration actually follows.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A buy/sell screen does not make the broader funnel ordinary commerce. The speaker directs viewers to deposit Bitcoin on BitConnect, explicitly invokes its lending minimum, and explains purchasing its coin. The dashboard shown during that walkthrough advertises daily profit and capital back. There is no need to establish a completed payout or downline income to identify the promoted investment pathway.
